parameter.name: CP_TAIL_TAU_MS
parameter.what: issue #559: the clap tail's amplitude time constant in ms (E_CPTAIL RATE). Ships 80, plan084's one-record measurement on 80-200 ms. The take's own tail has two slopes (83 ms on 0.08-0.2 s, 315 ms on 0.3-1.2 s; cp-tail.json).

objective.name: CP max(decay, attack) ratio to the #379 WEAK bar
objective.why: #559's named CP failures: decay 15.9x and attack 6.2x (gate-379 section 4); the larger of the two, so neither can hide behind the other.

range_basis: 80 ships; 400 brackets the take's measured late slope (315 ms) from above. The slice is at the shipped tail level; the full 7 x 5 grid with the level is in docs/scorecard/chcp-559/cp-sweep-dev.json.
Committed in tools/probes/chcp_559_select.py (module docstring and grid constants, committed in b10a6e8f before any DEV point was rendered)

decision_rule.why: the gate's own resolution, not the spread of these data: a candidate is only told apart from another if the gap is a meaningful fraction of the 808's own one-step distance (the WEAK bar). At the ratios swept here (2 to 27) one bar is 4 to 50 % of the value; 10 % is the low end of that, so two points closer than 10 % are within the gate's own step and cannot justify a choice. Stated in this record before it was checked, from the decision's granularity.

evidence.regenerate: python3 tools/probes/chcp_559.py ch-sweep|cp-sweep, then python3 tools/probes/chcp_559.py tables
evidence.instrument: tools/probes/chcp_559.py through tools/perceptual_gate.py UNCHANGED (#379 gate, WEAK bar, single Fischer take); objective = median over the 5 frozen DEV strikes (480, 23110, 25283, 25409, 28527 frames) of the ratio to the bar. CH renders: the real DrumsFx block. CP renders: the exact fast path, asserted bit-identical to the real block (check-fast).

verdict.summary: U-shaped: 15.89 (80, shipped), 9.11 (120), 9.92 (160), 14.96, 20.75, 23.86, 27.14 (400). No point is a candidate: every decay improvement in the 2-D grid worsens the CP centroid past the frozen rule (+0.4 to +2.6 bar), because our tail carries the bursts' spectrum (centroid ~1830 Hz) where the take's is dark (~1220 Hz).

limits: NO PREDICTION BLOCK, deliberately: the committed CP-P prediction ('decay improves with tau ... the best P point is long and LOW') does not hold on this slice (U-shaped at the shipped level) and is recorded as FAILED rather than rewritten.
One slice of a 2-D grid; the dial is not separable from CP_TAIL_PEAK_DB (cp-tail-peak).
